headline: RBI Imposes Strict Restrictions on Ashok Sahakari Bank; Ban on All Transactions for 6 Months, Depositors Rush for Their Money
summary: The Reserve Bank of India imposed strict restrictions on Ashok Sahakari Bank, suspending all transactions for six months. Depositors have rushed to withdraw their money.
why: The RBI is India's central bank and banking regulator, and restrictions on a lender can affect depositor confidence across the cooperative banking sector.
